  medium    The macOS application firewall is disabled [fw.app_firewall_disabled]
            evidence  fw.global: Firewall is disabled. (State = 0)
            fix       Turn the application firewall on.
            impact    Every listening service on this machine accepts inbound connections without a
                      per-application decision, so a background agent that opens a port is reachable
                      by default.
            commands  sudo /usr/libexec/ApplicationFirewall/socketfilterfw --setglobalstate on
            caveat    This is a per-application filter, not a packet filter; it does not replace a
                      network firewall.
